hero_description: Taste Peranakan (Nyonya) cuisine, Portuguese-Eurasian devil's curry, and Malay kampung recipes on a guided food tour through Melaka's UNESCO heritage streets. This is the world's first fusion cuisine, still cooked by the families who created it.
intro_content: Melaka created the world's first fusion cuisine 600 years ago when Chinese traders married Malay women, creating Peranakan cooking. Then came the Portuguese, the Dutch, and the British. Every colonizer left something on the plate.

hero_description: Explore Ipoh's famous white coffee, bean sprout chicken, and old-town kopitiams. Our tours take you to Hakka family eateries and curry mee stalls that have been cooking the same way for generations.
intro_content: Ipoh was once the richest city in Malaysia, built on tin mining. That wealth attracted Hakka immigrants who brought a cuisine that has survived almost unchanged. Ipoh's food is a time capsule of Malaysian Chinese cooking.
